text: Ooh, that was some first day.
I'm sorry. I wish I could have done more.
You performed your duties quite satisfactorily.
That's right. It's not your fault, Gillian. Don't worry about it.
By the way, the chief is waiting for you.

Well, Seed, that was a pretty rough first assignment to draw. You made a great effort, though. I've studied the data transmitted back by Metal Gear, so I know all about what happened out there. It's too bad about Gibson. He was a great junker.
Seed, I need you to take over for him. You're the only one I've got left who can battle this snatcher menace.
